openHighFindings.summary: products_reserved_within_stock remains NOT VALID until the readiness gate is run against production data.

resolvedFindings: outbox retry had no jitter (thundering herd on a recovering dependency)
outbox exhaustion recorded as 'processed', indistinguishable from delivery
outbox completion had no compare-and-set; a stale worker could overwrite its successor
inventory lock order was documented but not implemented (deadlock to silent oversell)
inventory stock invariant enforced nowhere; products carried zero CHECK constraints
inventory reservation was best-effort; technical failure became an ordinary backorder
inventory stock update was read-then-write (TOCTOU)
client identity derived ad hoc in nine places; cf-connecting-ip was forgeable
ip-unknown was one shared bucket (accidental global denial of service)
abuse controls were per-replica in-memory Maps
audit_logs was fully mutable by the application role
readiness treated Redis as fatal, pulling the whole fleet on a cache blip
database deadlock retry ran inside the aborted transaction and could never succeed
slow-query log wrote bound parameter values (customer PII)
payment webhook signatureVerified never gated anything (CRITICAL)
checkout idempotency key was globally unique and returned another customer's order
checkout ownership derived from caller-supplied email/phone
checkout idempotency was read-then-write; concurrent submissions both did commerce work
checkout response spread the domain order, publishing customer PII
notification safety preflight returned PASS while unsafe
checkout principal was minted by the API, whose Set-Cookie never reaches the browser through SSR — every request got a new identity so the claim could never dedupe
authenticated customer session was never applied to the Commerce checkout route
legacy contact-scoped idempotency ran alongside the principal-scoped claim (two contradictory ownership models)
idempotency lease had no fencing token; a stale worker could overwrite its successor
order was persisted before any durable link to the idempotency record
checkout page read res.data.id while the DTO returned orderId — PesaPal handoff silently never started
checkout key was regenerated on every render, so only a same-render double-click was protected
reservation used an inverted stockHeld variable
migration 0058 initially used gen_random_bytes (pgcrypto), leaving the migration part-applied
takeover did not extend the lease in the same statement, so six concurrent takeovers produced six owners
route imported a repository type directly, violating the architecture boundary
checkout intent was resolved only inside the POST branch, so the initial GET issued no cookie and the template binding was a ReferenceError — the page was broken on first load while pnpm build passed
operation identity mixed in a caller-controlled hidden clientOrderKey field
operation identity used ambiguous space-joined concatenation instead of a length-prefixed encoding
every fenced mutation result was ignored, so the fence detected lease loss and the caller discarded the detection
order insert and claim link were two statements, leaving a crash window that orphaned orders
checkout request boundary was typed unknown on both customerDetails and items
storefront had no canonical authenticated-session helper, so a signed USER intent alone could outlive a logout
checkout orchestration lived in the HTTP route (289 lines), so transaction and recovery policy could only be exercised through HTTP
expected commerce decisions were identified by parsing error-message prefixes rather than typed outcomes
a retry after a partial success restarted the workflow instead of resuming from the durable order
fulfilment and notification failures were swallowed by console.error, leaving an order with no work item and nothing to alert on

resolvedFindings.resolution: Closed at a37fc2a. Fingerprint now covers delivery address and normalised contact phone/email, with a length-prefixed canonical encoding (a NUL separator is ambiguous once free text is included) and CHECKOUT_POLICY_VERSION bumped to checkout-v3-full-fingerprint so v2 values are unmatchable by construction. 18 behavioural tests.

Closed at a37fc2a. purgeExpired is state-aware: a row is removable only when its stage holds nothing unresolved, matching migration 0059 partial index; retained rows are counted and returned. Proven against real PostgreSQL — an expired checkout mid-payment is retained, an expired resolved one is still reclaimed.

Closed at a37fc2a. Cross-site refusal on the checkout POST, evaluated BEFORE the intent is resolved because resolving mints. Sec-Fetch-Site primary (needs no configuration), Origin then Referer fallback against PUBLIC_SITE_ORIGINS, fail-closed on no evidence. 30 behavioural tests.

Closed at c0b8ce6. StartOrderPaymentUseCase authorizes against the checkout that produced the order, reuses a live provider attempt instead of re-submitting, records PAYMENT_STARTED durably plus an ORDER_PAYMENT_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED side effect, and returns typed outcomes so no internal message or blanket 400 reaches the caller. 22 behavioural tests + real-PostgreSQL ownership and forward-only stage proofs.

Closed at b1364e6. Cart routes take the cart id from a SIGNED CREDENTIAL, never from the request; the id lives inside the signed claims. Ownership is bound and cross-checked against the verified session; a foreign cart is reported as CART_NOT_FOUND so the endpoint is not a cart-id oracle. GET /carts/:id removed (it put the id in a URL path); the admin lookup moved to GET /admin/carts/:id behind ORDERS_READ, which the customer route never had. Migration 0060 adds owner, version, expiry, quantity bounds and one-row-per-(cart,product). 44 behavioural tests + 25/25 real-PostgreSQL checks.

Closed at c2058c7. One pure OutboundGovernancePolicy used by email and SMS: ordered guards, typed decisions, each naming its guard as a code. A dry run now reports DRY_RUN rather than SENT — both adapters previously recorded a simulated message as delivered. PROVIDER_DELIVERY_ENABLED and CUSTOMER_COMMUNICATIONS_ENABLED are now actually enforced; they were read by neither adapter. A contradictory configuration BLOCKS and fails release readiness rather than returning WARN. 47 behavioural tests over the pure policy.

testTotals.note: tests/unit is fully green on a clean tree. The 12 Slice-09 artifact-scope guards read git status --porcelain and fail while the tree is dirty by design.
